counter_policy: stats().inferences minimum of three and fixed two-point growth slopes decide; wall time advises
instruction_policy: perf instructions:u minimum of three, one percent noise allowance unless a row declares its own beside the measurement that justified it

measurement.band: one percent unless a row declares its own. mork-native-add-8000 declares four: its minimum moved 1.605% across four runs and its samples spread 1.992% within one, where every other row moved under 0.240%. Adding 8000 clauses to a dynamic predicate grows SWI's clause store and its just-in-time index across resize thresholds, and where those land depends on allocation rather than on the workload.
measurement.repin_note: 2026-08-31 re-pin: the landed engine set of that night, the transaction participant walk and outcome record (space_hooks.pl, +105 lines), the space-'used' clause test (lifecycle.pl) and lib_tabling's targeted invalidation replacing abolish_all_tables/0, together with the petta matcher adoption, which is what the native match rows here gain. Per-file isolation was done on the engine-bench lane (two inert clauses = 0, the new predicate called 0 times at boot, the effects.pl message reverted = unchanged) and is not repeated per seat; min-of-3 per row.

p43_loaded_image_repin_comment: RE-PINNED 2026-09-02 after static contract discharge changed the engine image loaded beside MORK. Every inference count is byte-identical before and after, so no MORK operation performs more logical work. Equal-length q42/p43 controls isolate the deterministic instruction movements: batch-add-500 12998044 to 14024157 (+7.895%), native-add-500 6001006 to 5758648 (-4.039%), native-add-2000 23944355 to 22981049 (-4.023%), and mork-match-first-500 14665892 to 14173613 (-3.357%). The six bound native-match rows move by the same fixed 14310 to 14313 instructions, +1.200% to +1.212%, at 500, 2000 and 8000 atoms. The 500-only batch and MORK-match shifts are fixed process costs that amortize below the band at larger sizes. A second current-checkout comparison also places native-add-8000 below its old 4% band at 96654437, so its pin moves 100754247 to the update run's 96784274; the checkout-local control-window floor moves 28828 to 28313. Only the twelve rows that left their bands are updated, and CPU readings under shared load remain at their earlier values. [measured: min-of-three controlled instructions and inference counts before and after P43; command=CHECK_PY=$CHECK_PY sh extensions/mork/bench.sh --update; fixture=equal-length q42 and p43 worktrees with libmork_ffi.so and morklib.so present; commit=6872eee94500bc0246eabaa40d7175c498cc32ab]
release_0_7_0_layout_repin_comment: RE-PINNED 2026-09-04 for the 0.7.0 release work. Instruction-only, and the evidence that it is LAYOUT rather than work is that the inference counts are byte-identical across three samples on every row that pins one: batch-add-500 17529, per-atom-add-500 36014, native-add-500 7533, mork-match-first-500 13507, native-match-first-500 1707. The engine image grew this session -- a seam declaration, the tracer's truncation flag and cell budget, the fast-cache scan's clauses -- and qlf_boot.pl regenerates the umbrella QLF files, so the same logical work is reached through differently placed code. That is the same mechanism this file already records for the provenance-only WORKTREE replacement that moved the MORK control-window floor 28313 to 28808. No row's inference count moved [measured 2026-09-04; command=sh extensions/mork/bench.sh --update; fixture=warm main-checkout engine artifacts; commit=WORKTREE]
